description: This file contains a PHP class 'Special' that is part of the OpenCart admin module extension. It handles the display, creation, editing, and deletion of 'special' modules within the OpenCart system, including rendering views and processing AJAX requests for module management.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'special' modules in the OpenCart admin interface, including rendering the configuration page and handling module CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the special module configuration page, initializing data and loading the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updates to a special module, validating permissions and input, then updating the module record.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new special module with default values, after permission check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module, provided user has permission.
